(Multiple Choice Q & A)

1 .Who is the author of the recently discussed book "Belonging: A Journey of Love"?
हाल ही में चर्चा में रही पुस्तक "बिलांगिंग: ए जर्नी ऑफ लव" की लेखिका कौन हैं?
Answer: - Sonia Gandhi / सोनिया गांधी

2 .Which Indian-origin politician was elected as the Mayor of Los Angeles in 2026?
2026 में किस भारतीय मूल की राजनेता को लॉस एंजिल्स के मेयर के रूप में चुना गया है?
Answer: - Nithya Raman / नित्या रमन

3 .Which Indian organization was honored with the global Kochon Prize 2026 for its contribution in fighting tuberculosis (TB)?
तपेदिक (टीबी) से निपटने में योगदान के लिए किस भारतीय संगठन को वैश्विक कोचन पुरस्कार 2026 से सम्मानित किया गया?
Answer: - REACH (Resource group for Education and Advocacy for Community Health) / रीच

4 .Where was the 13th International Conference of Asian Political Parties (ICAPP) held in 2026?
2026 में 13वें एशियाई राजनीतिक दलों के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन (ICAPP) का आयोजन कहाँ किया गया?
Answer: - Seoul, South Korea / सियोल, दक्षिण कोरिया

5 .Who recently became the youngest driver in history to win the Formula One World Championship?
हाल ही में फॉर्मूला वन विश्व चैम्पियनशिप जीतने वाले इतिहास के सबसे कम उम्र के ड्राइवर कौन बने हैं?
Answer: - Andrea Kimi Antonelli / एंड्रिया किमी एंटोनेली

6 .Which Indian badminton player won the silver medal in the women's event at the 2026 Summer Youth Olympics held in Dakar?
डकार में आयोजित 2026 ग्रीष्मकालीन युवा ओलंपिक में किस भारतीय बैडमिंटन खिलाड़ी ने महिला स्पर्धा में रजत पदक जीता?
Answer: - Tanvi Patri / तन्वी पत्री

7 .Who became the first Indian male swimmer to win a medal at the Summer Youth Olympics by securing a bronze medal in the 200m butterfly event?
200 मीटर बटरफ्लाई स्पर्धा में कांस्य पदक हासिल करके ग्रीष्मकालीन युवा ओलंपिक में पदक जीतने वाले पहले भारतीय पुरुष तैराक कौन बने हैं?
Answer: - Tirthank Pegu / तीर्थंक पेगू

8 .Which Indian fast bowler announced his retirement from Test cricket in November 2026?
किस भारतीय तेज गेंदबाज ने नवंबर 2026 में टेस्ट क्रिकेट से संन्यास की घोषणा की?
Answer: - Mohammed Shami / मोहम्मद शमी

9 .K.V. Narayana, who passed away recently, was a renowned critic, linguist, and Sahitya Akademi Award winner of which language?
के.वी. नारायण जिनका हाल ही में निधन हुआ, किस भाषा के प्रसिद्ध आलोचक, भाषाविद् और साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार विजेता थे?
Answer: - Kannada / कन्नड़

10 .According to RBI data as of March 2026, which country was the largest destination for India's Outward Direct Investment (ODI)?
मार्च 2026 के आरबीआई आंकड़ों के अनुसार, भारत के प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश (ODI) का सबसे बड़ा गंतव्य कौन-सा देश था?
Answer: - Singapore / सिंगापुर

11 .Which organization launched a drive against unauthorized e-catering websites and mobile apps on Indian Railways in November 2026?
नवंबर 2026 में भारतीय रेलवे पर अनधिकृत ई-कैटरिंग वेबसाइटों और मोबाइल ऐप के विरुद्ध अभियान किस संगठन ने शुरू किया?
Answer: - Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) / भारतीय रेलवे खानपान एवं पर्यटन निगम (IRCTC)

12 .Which edition of Deepotsav was organized in Ayodhya in November 2026?
नवंबर 2026 में अयोध्या में दीपोत्सव का कौन-सा संस्करण आयोजित किया गया?
Answer: - 10th edition / 10वाँ संस्करण

The Hindu Vocabulary 

1. Ramifications (Noun)
Meaning: The complex or unwelcome consequences of an action or event.
Hindi: परिणाम, जटिलताएँ।
Synonyms: Consequences, repercussions, outcomes.
Antonyms: Causes, origins, sources.
Example: Getting rid of all mosquitoes could have major ecological ramifications.
Related Words: Ramify (verb).

2. Futile (Adjective)
Meaning: Incapable of producing any useful result; pointless.
Hindi: व्यर्थ, निरर्थक।
Synonyms: Vain, fruitless, useless.
Antonyms: Effective, fruitful, useful.
Example: Some scientists believe using only insecticides to eradicate mosquitoes is futile due to their adaptability.
Related Words: Futility (noun), futilely (adverb).

3. Bonhomie (Noun)
Meaning: Cheerful friendliness; geniality.
Hindi: मिलनसारिता, खुशमिज़ाजी।
Synonyms: Conviviality, affability, geniality.
Antonyms: Hostility, animosity, coldness.
Example: A rate cut depends on how the renewed bonhomie between India and the U.S. progresses.
Related Words: N/A.

4. Disparagingly (Adverb)
Meaning: In a way that expresses criticism or a low opinion.
Hindi: अपमानजनक ढंग से।
Synonyms: Derogatorily, contemptuously, scornfully.
Antonyms: Respectfully, admiringly, complimentary.
Example: The article talks disparagingly about India, stating it stood nowhere in the race between China and the U.S..
Related Words: Disparage (verb), disparaging (adjective).

5. Phalanx (Noun)
Meaning: A group of people standing or moving forward closely together.
Hindi: व्यूह, दल।
Synonyms: Formation, legion, cohort.
Antonyms: Scattering, individual.
Example: India, China, and Russia constitute a strong phalanx against those wanting to disrupt the world order.
Related Words: N/A.

6. Ephemeral (Adjective)
Meaning: Lasting for a very short time.
Hindi: क्षणिक, अल्पकालिक।
Synonyms: Transitory, fleeting, short-lived.
Antonyms: Permanent, enduring, everlasting.
Example: The U.S.'s current lead in technology is, at best, ephemeral.
Related Words: Ephemerally (adverb), ephemerality (noun).

7. Crucible (Noun)
Meaning: A situation of severe trial, leading to the creation of something new.
Hindi: कठिन परीक्षा, अग्निपरीक्षा।
Synonyms: Trial, ordeal, test, gauntlet.
Antonyms: Comfort, ease, sanctuary.
Example: India's start-up economy is a crucible of global innovation.
Related Words: N/A.

8. Edifices (Noun)
Meaning: Large, imposing buildings or complex structures.
Hindi: भव्य इमारतें, विशाल रचनाएँ।
Synonyms: Structures, monuments, buildings.
Antonyms: Huts, shacks, ruins.
Example: The company's machinery was present at all the major edifices built across the country, like the new Parliament.
Related Words: Edifice (singular noun), edify (verb).

9. Strident (Adjective)
Meaning: Loud and harsh; presenting a point of view in an excessively forceful way.
Hindi: कर्कश, तीखा।
Synonyms: Harsh, raucous, shrill, grating.
Antonyms: Soft, gentle, mellow, soothing.
Example: The Turkish President has criticised Israel with strident rhetoric since the start of the war.
Related Words: Stridently (adverb), stridency (noun).

10. Malady (Noun)
Meaning: A disease, ailment, or serious problem.
Hindi: रोग, व्याधि।
Synonyms: Sickness, illness, affliction.
Antonyms: Health, wellness, remedy.
Example: In 2025, a mysterious malady descended on the village of Turakapalem.
Related Words: N/A.

#Citizenship

The Citizenship Act of 1955 prescribes five ways of acquiring citizenship, viz, birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory: 

🔺️ BY BIRTH

🔸️ A person born in India on or after January 26, 1950 but before July 1, 1987 is a citizen of India by birth irrespective of the nationality of his  parents. 

🔸️ A person born in India on or after July 1, 1987 is considered as a citizen of India only if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ Further, those born in India on or after December 3, 2004 are considered citizens of India only if both of their parents are citizens of  India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an  illegal migrant at the time of their birth.
 
🔸️ The children of foreign diplomats posted in India and enemy aliens  cannot acquire Indian citizenship by birth.

➼ बहुराष्ट्रीय नौसैनिक अभ्यास मालाबार 2026 का आयोजन योकोसुका नौसैनिक अड्डे, जापान में किया जा रहा है।
The multinational naval exercise Malabar 2026 is being conducted at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan.

➼ मालाबार 2026 नौसैनिक अभ्यास में भारतीय नौसेना का युद्धपोत INS सह्याद्रि भाग लेगा।
The Indian Navy warship INS Sahyadri will participate in the Malabar 2026 naval exercise.

➼ सक्रिय अंतरिक्ष मलबा हटाने और कक्षा में उपग्रह सेवाओं के लिए Cosmoserve Space की ‘Base 1’ सुविधा का उद्घाटन हैदराबाद में किया गया।
The ‘Base 1’ facility of Cosmoserve Space, for active space debris removal and in-orbit satellite servicing, was inaugurated in Hyderabad.

➼ नवंबर 2026 में पुर्तगाल के प्रसिद्ध फुटबॉल खिलाड़ी क्रिस्टियानो रोनाल्डो ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय फुटबॉल से संन्यास की घोषणा की।
Famous Portuguese footballer Cristiano Ronaldo announced his retirement from international football in November 2026.

➼ निर्मला लक्ष्मण ने अपनी पुस्तक ‘The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community’ के लिए वर्ष 2026 का सर्वश्रेष्ठ अंतरराष्ट्रीय गैर-कथा पुस्तक शारजाह पुरस्कार जीता।
Nirmala Lakshman won the 2026 Sharjah Award for Best International Non-Fiction Book for her book ‘The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community’.

➼ नवंबर 2026 में केंद्रीय मंत्रालयों और विभागों में सर्वाधिक भवनों पर सौर ऊर्जा प्रणाली स्थापित करने के लिए रेल मंत्रालय को PM Surya Ghar Excellence Award मिला।
The Ministry of Railways received the PM Surya Ghar Excellence Award in November 2026 for installing solar energy systems on the highest number of buildings across central ministries and departments.

➼ विश्व सुनामी जागरूकता दिवस 2026 की थीम “Be Tsunami Ready: Resilience Starts With You” थी।
The theme of World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026 was “Be Tsunami Ready: Resilience Starts With You”.

➼ नवंबर 2026 में राजतरंगिणी, महाभारत और अर्थशास्त्र को यूनेस्को के Memory of the World Asia-Pacific Regional Register में शामिल किया गया।
In November 2026, Rajatarangini, Mahabharata and Arthashastra were included in UNESCO’s Memory of the World Asia-Pacific Regional Register.

➼ राजकुमारी लनचेनबी चानू डकार में कांस्य पदक जीतकर युवा ओलंपिक खेलों में वुशु पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय बनीं।
Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu became the first Indian to win a Wushu medal at the Youth Olympic Games by securing a bronze medal in Dakar.
